validate.unit: Unit must be mg/dL or mmol/L.
validate.range_low: Target low must be between 40 and 200 mg/dL.
validate.range_high: Target high must be above the low value and at most 400 mg/dL.
validate.thresholds: Very low must be between 20 and the target low, and very high between the target high and 600 mg/dL.
validate.minutes: Minutes before and after must be between 0 and 240.
validate.chart_theme: Chart theme must be light or dark.
validate.chart_size: Chart size must be standard or large.
validate.chart_lead: Chart lead-in must be between 0 and 240 minutes.
validate.chart_line: Chart line thickness must be between 1 and 4.
validate.poll: The polling interval must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
validate.post_buffer: The delayed reprocess buffer must be between 0 and 180 minutes.
validate.retention: Retention must be between 0 and 3650 days.
validate.ntfy_url: The ntfy URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.webhook_url: The webhook URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.email_to: The notification email address is not valid.
validate.smtp_port: The SMTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
validate.smtp_sender: The SMTP sender address is not valid.
validate.gap_alert: The glucose gap alert must be between 0 and 168 hours.
validate.public_url: The public URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.smtp_needs: SMTP needs a port and a sender address.
validate.panel_order: Chart panel order must only list activity, band, dots, hr.
validate.language: Language must be auto or one of the installed languages.
validate.artifact_mode: Suspected artifacts must be handled as flagged or exclude.
validate.overview_range: The default Overview range must be one of {ranges}.
validate.overview_layout: The Overview layout is not valid JSON: {error}
